{{Quote|Number 1: Togruta-style Shili cheese dog with cup of soup 5.5 credits|The number 1 Pantoran Plate Special for Taungsday|<ref name="DaD" />}}
'''Shili cheese dogs''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] served at the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] known as [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] due to the fact that they were considered delicious by the eatery's owner, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]]. The dish cost 5.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was served with a cup of [[Soup/Legends|soup]] as one of the lunch and dinner [[Pantoran Plate Specials]] available on [[Taungsday/Legends|Taungsday]]. The establishment's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] and owner, the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], made the dogs in the style of the [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="DaD" /> of the planet [[Shili/Legends|Shili]].<ref name="NEGTAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The dish was served at Dex's<ref name="DaD" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|At its most basic level, this thinking led to a number of puns&mdash;Panna cakes, Wol Cabasshews, Xizor salad, Sic-Six-layer cake, Tibanna split and Shili cheese dog among them&mdash;that are either inspired or stupid or both, depending on one's sense of humor.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Shili cheese dogs were first mentioned in the [[2009]] [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] exclusive article, "[[Dining at Dex's]]," which was written as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner by [[Gregory Walker]].<ref name="DaD" /> Their name was a pun on real world [[Wikipedia:Chili dog|chili cheese dogs]].<ref name="Blog" />
